about: Doc 86, V2 (tools/story_words.py; the Editor's Problems list): words a story may never say, each a whole word in any case, with what to say instead. The world has wolves (their young are pups), two powers only (the Bright One and the Dark One), and private messages (never tells).

forbidden.god: the Bright One (or, malevolently, the Dark One)
forbidden.gods: the Bright One and the Dark One
forbidden.deity: the Bright One or the Dark One
forbidden.deities: the Bright One and the Dark One
